objs.name: document
objs.description: A centrally managed information object representing a policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, or other controlled document, subject to creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type-based abbreviation prefix assigned to the document (e.g., RL for guideline), combined with a consecutive number.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g., policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction) determining its level in the document pyramid.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g., editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the document, incremented with each new revision cycle.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version of the document is considered valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable time period (default 3 years) defining how long a document version remains valid before requiring a validity extension check.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable time period (default 10 years) defining how long an invalidated document is retained before physical deletion.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: The scope or area of validity for which the document applies.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents, master data or related objects referenced by this document.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications associated with or referenced by the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or organizational entities for which the document is relevant.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Specific organizational or geographic areas where the document applies.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The original language of the document content.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: The underlying Office format (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) used to create and edit the document content.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group assignment controlling which readers can view the released document.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Person assigned as the primary author responsible for the document, defaulting to the creator.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional persons assigned personal change rights on the document alongside the author.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person(s) assigned to check the document for technical and/or formal correctness during the review step.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person(s) authorized to approve and release the document for distribution to readers.

attributes.name: reviewer_translation
attributes.description: Person(s) assigned to review translated versions of the document.

attributes.name: releaser_translation
attributes.description: Person(s) assigned to release translated versions of the document.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: User groups and persons on the distribution list who receive email notification upon release of a new version.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: User groups and persons on the distribution list who must actively confirm acknowledgement upon release of a new version.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specification of which clients in a multi-client system can see the document.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document object attached to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and passes through all statuses of the main document's release process. Its creation, modification or archiving triggers a new version of the main document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment, following the same release process statuses as the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the attachment, managed independently but synchronized with the main document release.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary document object attached to a main document that is not subject to the release cycle and can be published directly via property switches. Its creation, modification or deletion has no effect on the main document version.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Switch in properties indicating whether the additional information is released and published directly.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal for changes to an existing released document, created and managed independently without affecting the document's content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g., created, scheduled for implementation, completed).

attributes.name: editing_notes
attributes.description: Documentation by the author of the underlying document regarding the processing of the change proposal.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend validity, trigger revision, or initiate invalidation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the validity extension request.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a document and withdraw it from circulation, triggering an archiving process that revokes all authorizations except for the archive group.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the override request.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated document and its attachments, restoring original metadata, authorizations, and distribution settings with a new version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the reactivation request.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new documents, supporting TAG technology for automatic metadata insertion.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users defined in the system for assigning collective authorizations, reader access, distribution, and acknowledgement responsibilities.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name identifying the user group (e.g., Reader - Document Management, Authors, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive).

objs.name: person
objs.description: An individual user in the system who can be assigned roles such as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, or reader and participates in workflows.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature provided by workflow participants to confirm completion of their workflow task (creation, review, or release), documented per released version.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: The person who provided the electronic signature.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the signature was provided.

attributes.name: workflow_step
attributes.description: The step in the release process (Creator, Review, Release) at which the signature was given.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity in the system to which documents can be linked for structured storage and reference.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process defined in the system to which documents can be linked for process-specific filing and reference.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A risk object in the system that can be linked to documents for reference and association.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: A master data object representing an IT application that can be referenced by documents.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A record of a user's active confirmation that they have read and noted a released document version, tracked and documented per person.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Whether the acknowledgement has been confirmed or is still pending.

attributes.name: confirmed_by
attributes.description: The person who confirmed the acknowledgement.

attributes.name: confirmation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the acknowledgement was confirmed.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: The collection of user groups and persons assigned to a document for distribution purposes, controlling both email notifications and acknowledgement requirements upon release.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process instance managing the approval steps (Creator, Review, Release) for documents, validity extensions, overrides, reactivations, and acknowledgements.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the workflow (e.g., active, completed, rejected, canceled).

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of workflow (e.g., release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement, translation release).

objs.name: document_type_configuration
objs.description: System configuration defining properties for each document type including type abbreviation, available templates, validity period, and archive duration.

attributes.name: type_abbreviation
attributes.description: The abbreviation code used in document numbering for this document type (e.g., RL for guideline).

attributes.name: validity_period
attributes.description: The default period of extended validity configured for this document type (default 3 years).

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: The default archive retention period configured for this document type (default 10 years).

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document is created in the system by attaching a new information object with selection of the corresponding document type and optionally a template.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: The metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the implemented editing client in the corresponding local Office component.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: The document is automatically and system-supported converted to PDF after saving, and the current version is displayed on the web.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step release process (Creator - Review - Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the creation step as the first workflow step in the release process with an electronic signature.

evts.name: complete_review_step
evts.description: A reviewer completes the review step by confirming technical and/or formal correctness of the document with an electronic signature.

evts.name: reject_review_step
evts.description: A reviewer rejects the document during the review step, causing the workflow to be canceled for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: complete_release_step
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document with an electronic signature, making the document visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: reject_release_step
evts.description: A releaser rejects the document during the release step, causing the workflow to be canceled for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and becomes visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_editing_version
evts.description: A new version of a released document is automatically created in editing status when a revision is initiated, retaining all data from the previous version.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: A controlled attachment is added to a document, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived with the release of the next version of the main document, revoking all rights except for the archive group.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is added to a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: modify_additional_info
evts.description: An existing additional information object is modified without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is deleted from a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is released and published directly via a switch in the properties.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing released document by an employee with author rights, without affecting the document content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal_for_implementation
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document in which the note about the change proposal can be printed.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of an assigned change proposal, marking it as completed so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: generate_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the document's validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The validity of a document is confirmed during the validity extension check, updating the Valid Until date by the default period and deleting the request.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document and withdraw it from circulation.

evts.name: start_override_workflow
evts.description: The workflow for processing the override request is started automatically after the request is created.

evts.name: complete_override_review
evts.description: The reviewer completes the review of the override request.

evts.name: approve_override
evts.description: The releaser approves the override, setting the document status to Out of Force and revoking all rights except for the archive group.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The last valid and approved version of the document is given the status Out of Force, existing edited versions are deleted, and the archive duration begins.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A request for reactivation is created by the Business Admin group for a previously invalidated document.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The initiator confirms the reactivation, creating a new version of the document with restored metadata, authorizations, and distribution settings.

evts.name: reactivate_attachments
evts.description: Attachments archived with the invalidated document are reactivated along with the document.

evts.name: send_distribution_email_notification
evts.description: Users and user groups assigned for distribution by info are informed by email notification when a new document version is released.

evts.name: send_acknowledgement_request
evts.description: Users and user groups assigned for distribution for acknowledgement are requested by email to actively confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A person confirms acknowledgement of a released document version through a workflow-supported task without a signature.

evts.name: notify_all_acknowledgements_confirmed
evts.description: The author team of the document receives a notification that all persons in the distribution list have confirmed acknowledgement of the current version.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: The released content of a document is translated into another language.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: The reviewer for translation checks the translated version of the document.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The releaser for translation approves and releases the translated version, making it visible to authorized readers in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: physical_deletion
evts.description: After the archive period has expired, the document and its archived attachments are physically deleted from the system.

evts.name: assign_authorizations
evts.description: Group and person-related authorizations are assigned to a document including reader, author, co-author, reviewer, and releaser roles.

o2o.description: A document can have one or more attachments that are controlled and versioned with it.
A document can have one or more additional information objects supplementing it.
A change proposal belongs to and is displayed within a specific document.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document whose validity needs to be checked.
A request for override is created for a specific document to initiate its invalidation.
A request for reactivation references the specific invalidated document to be reactivated.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type and selected when creating new documents.
Documents can reference other documents for cross-linking and navigation.
Documents can be linked to processes for process-specific filing and reference.
Documents can be linked to organizational units for structured storage.
Documents can be linked to risks for reference and association.
Documents can reference IT applications as master data.
Each document has a distribution list defining the user groups and persons for its distribution.
A distribution list contains user groups whose members receive distribution notifications or acknowledgement tasks.
A distribution list can contain individual persons directly assigned for distribution.
A user group contains persons who inherit the group's authorizations and assignments.
Each document belongs to a document type configuration that defines its abbreviation, validity, and archive settings.
Electronic signatures of workflow participants are documented per released version of a document.
Acknowledgement records are tracked per document version for persons on the distribution for acknowledgement list.
